GOAL: add a `--prefix` option to slice_probe.py with choices none (default, behaviour unchanged), missed_window and secure_route. A prefix is a fixed list of commands defined in ONE table at the top of the file. missed_window: take the five commands of the missed-window journey in tests/test_phase1_slice_playthroughs.py exactly as written there for turns 1-5 (the observation command that earns an outcome in that journey must be replaced by a neutral accepted command so that NO outcome and no recovery is earned in the prefix; verify with the scripted dry run that transfer_window_missed becomes true on turn 5 and none of the advantage facts are asserted). secure_route: 'Check the loading docks for signs of activity.', 'Look through the observation shaft at the people below.', 'Ask Brandon about the transfer route.'. During the prefix turns the probe sends the scripted command instead of asking the raw player (no player request spent, no player budget event) and the raw player's transcript screen still includes those commands and responses so it can continue; after the prefix the raw player plays as before, same stop rules (2B, story end, 30 commands total including the prefix). Each row records `prefix` and `scripted_turns` and each per-turn record gets `scripted` true/false. The checker must require the new row fields and accept prefix none. Update the dry run so --prefix works offline with the scripted provider (dry mode may script the post-prefix continuation with commands that reach 2B, as the existing dry run does; for missed_window use the recovery command 'Follow Brandon through the service entrance.'). Live mode still requires --confirm.

TESTS: extend tests/test_slice_probe.py (hermetic): dry runs for each prefix write results.json that pass the checker; in missed_window the prefix leaves no advantage fact and sets transfer_window_missed by turn 5; scripted turns spend no player requests (use the fake player to count calls); prefix none output is unchanged from before in shape. No network.

OWNED FILES: scripts/ringer/phase1/slice_probe.py, scripts/ringer/phase1/check_slice_probe.py, tests/test_slice_probe.py. Nothing else.

HOW TO RUN: first confirm PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)" prints a path inside the cwd. Dry run: PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/scripts/ringer/stage7 TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/phase1/slice_probe.py --n 1 --dry-run --prefix missed_window --out /tmp/slice-dry-m (and secure_route) then check_slice_probe.py <dir> 1 --mode dry. Focused tests: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp .../.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov tests/test_slice_probe.py. Full suite must end green: same with -n auto and no file args.
